blocks.text: BEIJING — A Chinese official has been sentenced to death for spying for a foreign country, a government-linked publisher said Monday. Gold Wall Press, a publishing company associated with China’s National Administration of State Secrets Protection, said the convicted person was surnamed Ma and was approached and recruited by a foreign intelligence service while working abroad.
